decoy-4_2-760-160.caption: Wenda, peeking over a wall in the same hat and glasses. Every model chose her over Waldo.

decoy-5_11-560-320.caption: Wenda, stripes and all, under the wall of clocks. Every model preferred her to Waldo's half-hidden head.

decoy-3_11-520-40.caption: Wenda among the spear carriers, striped from hat to stockings, while Waldo hides down in the cave.

decoy-4_1-400-80.caption: Wenda, grinning from behind a post on the film set. Only Luna looked past her to Waldo.

decoy-4_5-320-680.caption: Waldo's hat, glasses and striped sleeves on someone else, beside an aproned man. Only Luna found Waldo.

decoy-2_12-840-240.caption: A blond lookalike in the full outfit, on the same balcony as Waldo. Only d1-ultra told them apart.

decoy-5_1-200-480.caption: Wenda, grinning beside a blonde woman in yellow, while Waldo is pressed against the top edge.

decoy-5_4-880-560.caption: Wenda, among clowns and costumes. Waldo is up and to the left, beside a teddy bear.

decoy-1_1-1200-120.caption: Wenda in the full hat, glasses and stripes. Her dark hair flicks out below her chin, which at tile size passes for a moustache.

decoy-4_9-880-400.caption: A grinning kid in a Waldo bobble hat and striped scarf. No glasses, which apparently didn't matter.

decoy-1_2-800-640.caption: Wenda among the runners on the beach. d1-ultra, the overall leader, fell for this one.

decoy-6_3-80-320.caption: A grinning face in a red hat and glasses, half hidden behind a sea monster.

decoy-3_4-840-360.caption: No lookalike at all, just a scrum of ball players in red and white. Close enough, apparently.

hardest.1_1: In plain sight against a white wall, carrying a spade, gear and a walking stick.
hardest.2_12: In plain sight on a studio balcony beside a yellow bird costume, with lookalikes nearby.
hardest.3_3: Tucked into a small crowd between a ribbed green roof and a yellow tower, face in shadow.
hardest.3_4: Shoulder to shoulder with hooded ball players. Hat and stripes show; the face is a dark smudge.
hardest.3_11: In a dark cave between blue-hooded hunters hauling rope. Head and a patch of stripes.
hardest.4_1: Squeezed into a crowd behind a blond man with a spear: glasses, dark hair, a sliver of stripes.
hardest.4_2: Only his face, peeking over a white wall beside a man in a red waistcoat.
hardest.4_4: Just his head, bobbing among a column of soldiers in white kepis.
hardest.4_5: Just his face, peering out at the edge of the set, right above a cameraman.
hardest.4_9: Only his face, tucked under a man's elbow in a crowd behind a beige ledge.
hardest.5_1: Pressed against the top edge: head and collar between a red-clad figure and a woman in a bonnet.
hardest.5_4: Face and bobble hat, wedged between a man in yellow and a large teddy bear.
hardest.5_11: Under a wall of clocks, only his head shows, cut off by the bottom edge among white-hatted men.
hardest.6_3: One face in a tight rank of bearded sailors in white hats; the round glasses are the only tell.
hardest.6_9: In a boatload of pirates under a Jolly Roger, face and hat behind a raised cutlass.

models.d1-ultra: Most finds of the nine, and the only one to spot Waldo in scene 24. Still fell for Wenda on the beach in scene 2.
models.decider: $0.0022 a scene and a 9.1-second median. Fooled by Wenda in scene 1, but not by her on the beach in scene 2.
models.clef: The priciest at $0.0274 a scene, yet no more accurate than models costing under a tenth as much.
models.d1: Half the price of d1-ultra at $0.0026 a scene, and fooled by nearly every decoy on this page.
models.jev: One call per scene instead of one per tile, and the quickest typical search at 2.6 s. The only model to find Waldo in scenes 60 and 65.
models.clef-flash: Despite the name, the slowest typical search at 11.4 s, for $0.0043 a scene.
models.clef-omni: Second priciest at $0.0170 a scene. With d1-ultra, the only model to find Waldo in scenes 26 and 49.
models.span-02: The cheapest at $0.0020 a scene. Picked the blond lookalike in scene 24 over the real Waldo.
models.luna: The lowest found rate, but the only model to find Waldo in scenes 35 and 39, where most took a lookalike.
